notes: 取消「生成退出后执行的脚本」功能：移除 /config-sync/prepare 路由、前端动作卡与三份 .cmd 生成逻辑；推送/拉取/还原统一走「点按钮排队 → DSH 退出后 post-exit.ps1 自动执行 → 重启」的立即机制，其余功能不变。
notesEn: Removed the "generate post-exit scripts" feature: dropped the /config-sync/prepare route, the front-end action card and the three .cmd generators. Push/pull/restore now all use the queue → exit → post-exit.ps1 → restart flow; everything else is unchanged.
